assertions.name: three_factor_multiplicative_closure_refuted
assertions.source: The proposed miss=E(k)·amp(A_light)·parity(k) product is refuted: the k=3-normalized k=2 envelope varies 0.003/0.483/0.800 across A_light=1/2/3 (T1), and the miss is nonzero at k=2 so a pure Brunnian triple hard-gate is also refuted (T2). Honest structure = additive 2-channel (k=3-peaked 3-cluster ⊕ A_light-graded pairwise). Scope-(a); no fit.

description: R11-a (z2bn/#3808): derive-or-refute the proposed 3-FACTOR multiplicative closure miss(k,A_light)=E(k)·amp(A_light)·parity(k) of the deuteron/triton/neutron-ladder miss (consumes the committed R10 deuteron-ladder-falsification witness; no recompute). (T1) Multiplicative separability REFUTED: normalizing each ladder by its k=3 peak gives a k=2 envelope 0.003/0.483/0.800 across A_light=1/2/3 (>250× spread) — the miss is not E(k)·amp(A). (T2) Pure Brunnian μ̄₁₂₃ triple hard-gate REFUTED: miss is nonzero at k=2 (¹⁰B 2.81, ¹¹B 6.44 MeV), so a triple-linking-only envelope is excluded; μ̄₁₂₃ grounds the k=3 PEAK (first irreducible 3-cluster term) not a hard gate. NET: the multiplicative closure is refuted; honest structure is ADDITIVE 2-channel (k=3-peaked 3-cluster ⊕ A_light-graded pairwise), consistent with R9 P1/P2 interior-max prunes; R11-a target = the additive split. Scope-(a), no fit, no wiring, magnitudes not interpreted.
